narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This comedic sketch satirizes a common social experience during festive holidays like Mid-Autumn Festival, where friends promise to stay all night at a BBQ but consistently provide various excuses to leave almost immediately after arriving, highlighting the ironic contrast between their words and actions.
